test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of Operation Akhand Prahar conducted by the Indian Army in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan?

options.text: To test the infantry capabilities of the newly formed RUDRA Brigade
To conduct routine desert warfare drills with armoured units
To showcase humanitarian assistance and disaster relief procedures
To validate integrated multi-domain operations across land, air, and technological domains

solution:
The correct answer is __**To validate integrated multi-domain operations across land, air, and technological domains.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Army conducted Exercise Akhand Prahar in Jaisalmer to validate its multi-domain warfighting capabilities and operational readiness of the newly formed RUDRA Brigade.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Akhand Prahar was aimed at validating integrated operations across land, air, and technological domains as part of Tri-Services Exercise Trishul.**
 
• It operationally validated the RUDRA Brigade, an all-arms integrated formation capable of infantry, armoured, mechanised, and air defence operations.
 
• The exercise evaluated next-generation battlefield technologies, including drones, counter-drone systems, and indigenous platforms.
 
• It strengthened inter-service coordination, particularly between the Indian Army and Indian Air Force, refining tactics and battlefield procedures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **RUDRA Brigade**__

 __
 
• An integrated all-arms formation designed for multi-domain warfare.
 
• Capable of infantry, mechanised infantry, armoured, and air defence operations.
 
• Name derives from ‘Rudra’ (Shiva), symbolising strength, and ‘Prachand’ meaning massive power.
 
 
 
• **Tri-Services Exercise Trishul**__
 __
 
• A joint military exercise integrating the Army, Air Force, and Navy.
 
• Focuses on interoperability and modern warfare capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Next-Generation Technologies Used**__
 __
 
• Drones and counter-drone systems for surveillance and force protection.
 
• Indigenous battlefield innovations aligned with Atmanirbharta (self-reliance).
 
 
 
• **JAI Mantra**__
 
 
• J – Jointness
 
• A – Atmanirbharta
 
• I – Innovation
 
• Framework guiding modernisation within the Indian Army.
